english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something enjoyable or amusing, such as a party or activity.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for an activity, experience, or day that is enjoyable.
Use 好玩 when the entertaining thing is an activity, game, or experience that is fun to take part in.
